description: This is a JUnit test class for the PredefinedShelfRepository in a Java Spring Boot project. It tests repository methods such as findByPredefinedShelfNameAndUser, findAllByUser, and countAllByUser, focusing on the behavior of predefined shelf retrieval and counting for a user.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfRepositoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing PredefinedShelfRepository methods related to predefined shelves for users.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test data by creating test users and shelves before each test.

methods.name: findCorrectShelf
methods.description: Tests that the repository correctly finds a predefined shelf by name and user.

methods.name: findByPredefinedShelfNameAndUserReturnsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that the repository returns empty when no shelves exist for the user.

methods.name: findAllByUser
methods.description: Checks that all shelves for a user are correctly retrieved.

methods.name: findAllByUserIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that an empty list is returned when no shelves exist for the user.

methods.name: countAllByUser
methods.description: Verifies the count of shelves for a user matches the expected number.

methods.name: createShelvesForUser
methods.description: Helper method to create and save predefined shelves for a given user.
